acs.criterion: `eh run` accepts `--result-file <path>`. After the run, the file contains exactly the run's final result text: the harness-native terminal result string for harnesses that define one, else all `assistant.text` content concatenated in stream order. The file is always created — empty when the run produced no result text (including error runs). Proof: subprocess tests per fake harness comparing file bytes against the canned expected result, including one no-result error case.
acs.evidence: src/headless-run.test.ts describe('--result-file'): per-harness test.each writes claude→'claude-result: fix the parser' (native result), codex/grok/opencode/pi→'saw: fix the parser' (concat); multi-turn concat→'part one\npart two'; no-result codex EH_TEST_CODEX_FAIL run→empty file at exit 66. `bun test src/headless-run.test.ts`: 44 pass, 0 fail.

acs.criterion: Invariant: `--result-file` changes nothing else — the NDJSON stream, exit code, and stderr are byte-identical with and without the flag (aside from the file write). Proof: subprocess test running the same fake-harness scenario twice, with and without the flag, asserting identical event streams and exit codes.
acs.evidence: src/headless-run.test.ts 'leaves the NDJSON stream, exit code, and stderr unchanged aside from the file write' runs the codex fake with and without --result-file and asserts equal parseEvents(stdout), equal exit codes, and equal stderr. Passes.

acs.criterion: README `### Headless runs` and DESIGN.md document `run.completed` as the guaranteed final NDJSON line, with a regression test asserting no event is ever emitted after it.
acs.evidence: README.md ### Headless runs: 'run.completed is emitted exactly once and is always the last NDJSON line ... nothing follows'. DESIGN.md Headless execution: 'run.completed is by construction the final NDJSON line ... no event can follow'. src/headless-run.test.ts 'emits run.completed as the final NDJSON line for a successful run / a semantic-error run' asserts completedIndex === events.length - 1. Passes. Write-failure edge case covered by review fix: writeResultFile now catches write errors (emits run.error, returns false) so run.completed is still the final line with a non-zero exit code; repro with an unwritable --result-file path yields exit 66 with run.completed as the final line.
